subject: Intro chat with Emi Ortega — availability check
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emi Ortega <emi.ortega@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0300
Subject: Intro chat with Emi Ortega — availability check

Hi Emi,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role — I'm Diego on the recruiting team at Redwood Inference. We'd love to schedule a quick 30-minute introductory screen to learn more about your background and share a bit about the role and team. Monica (hiring manager) will join as well.

Quick question: what timezone are you in so I can send options that map cleanly to your calendar? If it's easier, here are a few windows we have open next week (I've listed them in both Sao Paulo / BRT and US Eastern for convenience):

- Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–10:30 BRT / 08:00–08:30 ET
- Wed 2026-09-23 16:00–16:30 BRT / 14:00–14:30 ET
- Thu 2026-09-24 09:30–10:00 BRT / 07:30–08:00 ET

If none of those work, please send 2–3 windows that do and your timezone and I will confirm. The call will be ~30 minutes — intro + role context + time for your questions.

If you can, please attach an updated copy of your resume so I can share it with Monica ahead of the chat.

Thanks — look forward to connecting,

Diego Fernandez
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
(he/him)

Attachment: job_brief.pdf (one-pager)

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -0300

Hi Diego — thanks for the note!

I am in Sao Paulo (BRT, UTC-3). The windows that work best for me are:

- Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–11:00 BRT
- Wed 2026-09-23 16:00–16:30 BRT

I attached my latest resume. Looking forward to a short chat — please let me know which slot you confirm and the meeting link.

Thanks,
Emi Ortega
emi.ortega@gmail.com
+55 11 9 5555-0123
